scientific_integrity: Self-contained proof and reproducible finite checker; no independent mathematical audit or formal certification.
scientific_limitations: Standard unweighted Euclidean embedding and complete multipartite graphs only; metric projections proved for missing product vertices, not all interior points. Previously known matching-deletion subcase is credited, and priority remains provisional pending independent bibliographic review.
title: Barycentric projection simplices and exact deep-hole shells of multipartite PQ adjacency polytopes
